train_controlnet_flax: train a Flax ControlNet model on a custom image dataset using diffusers with JAX and Optax optimizer
parse_controlnet_args: parse command-line arguments for Flax ControlNet training including dataset paths, learning rate, and validation settings
build_controlnet_dataset: build a training dataset from HuggingFace hub or local disk with image, caption, and conditioning image columns
validate_controlnet_model: run validation on a trained ControlNet model and log generated images to wandb or local directory
save_controlnet_model_card: save a model card README with generated example images and metadata for a trained ControlNet model
